purpose: Prospectively declared, physically coherent parameter families for heterogeneous computational validation
claim_boundary: Literature- and record-constrained computational parameters; not independently identified node-level plants

evidence_classes.IDENTIFIED: Estimated from an independent input-output record with uncertainty and held-out predictive validation
evidence_classes.DATASHEET: Taken from an official manufacturer or platform specification
evidence_classes.LITERATURE_CONSTRAINED: Type and numerical scale constrained by a cited experimental source
evidence_classes.AUTHOR_DECLARED: Preregistered stress-test range not estimated from the tested platform
evidence_classes.NORMALIZED: Dimensionless ratio relative to a declared complete baseline plant

uav.source_note: Public UAV records constrain platform scale and actuator/fault channels but do not identify between-aircraft mass, drag and bandwidth jointly.

vehicle.source_note: CARMA2 records establish vehicle-to-vehicle command-response heterogeneity, but the present analysis does not uniquely identify lag, drag and authority.

motor.source_note: A complete experimentally estimated baseline prevents assembly of one virtual motor from unrelated literature values. Ratios remain preregistered computational perturbations.

robot.source_note: Normalized mobile-agent stress family; not identified from a specific robot fleet.

microgrid.source_note: Normalized inverter-machine stress family; not identified from one physical microgrid.

circuit.source_note: Normalized nonlinear-circuit stress family; not identified from separate physical oscillators.

water.source_note: Normalized tank-network stress family; not identified from a multi-tank plant.

structure.source_note: Normalized structural-mode stress family; not identified from separate physical specimens.
